svg.text: WIREFRAME BOARD 01 — COMPLETE PORTAL INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE & TAB MAP
Every Portal, Every Sidebar Group, and Every Sub-Tab Mapped to Eliminate Vertical Scroll & Clutter
History, Editor & Live Responses sit in top-level mode tabs + left drawer—never stacked 4,900px down.
Scholars & Staff tables stay clean; clicking a row opens a right slide-over drawer for actions & credentials.
Every student selector uses structured rows with instant [All | School-Assigned | Private] segmented tabs.
Students, Parents, Staff, Schools & Admins isolated cleanly.

g.text: • KPI Bar: Assigned Schools, School Learners, Private
• Today's Live Classes + Pending Grading Alerts
• Split View: Submission List (Left) + Grading Pane
• Filter by School Class or Private Learner
• Module Progress Checklists per Class / Learner
• Next Live Session Banner + Join Button
• Active Exam Alert (Ready to Start with Passcode)
• Direct Link / File Upload + Tutor Remarks
• Filtered to Student's Class & Personal Dispatches
• Enrolled Scholars Count, Active Classes & Tutors
• Quick Links: Onboard Student · Export Passcodes
• Clean Table + Slide-Over Student Detail Drawer
• Single & Bulk CSV Student Onboarding Modal
• Batch Generate / Copy Access Codes by Grade
• Unified View of Active Exams & Past Submissions
• Shows Assigned Tutor, Grade & Student Passcode
• Enroll Additional Child / Request Tutor Modal
